name: Pacifism
description: Uncheck any number of Conditions. For each Condition unchecked (twice for Troubled), roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, the creature clears all Conditions and cannot attack or be targeted by attacks until the start of your next turn. On a loss, it only clears all Conditions.
successes:
✨: The creature’s speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.

🌞: On a win, the effect instead lasts 1 minute.

💀: The spell has no effect on this creature. Check two Conditions.
